name: Badge
description: Short label or status. Soft by default; data-status adds a dot and 14px text for important states (stock, order).
useWhen: Showing a status that matters (In stock, Sold)
avoidWhen: More than one accent badge per viewport

examples.title: Colors
examples.description: Soft by default: tone surface with tone text.

examples.title: Solid badges
examples.description: data-style="solid" for strong emphasis, such as New or a counter.

examples.title: Outline badges
examples.description: Transparent with a tone border. Works on coloured surfaces.

examples.title: Status
examples.description: data-status adds a dot and 14px text for states that matter. Never rely on colour alone.

examples.title: Badge in a button
examples.description: A counter inside a button. The badge shrinks to fit the button size.
